entries.proposition: Aim and hypothesis: early plasma may increase haemorrhage before bleeding is controlled ('pop-the-clot'); the null was adopted for survival.
entries.snippet: We therefore hypothesized that FFP will increase hemorrhage in a UCHS animal model.
